items.title: B2B operations platform
items.context: Advertising agencies needed a single place to run campaign workflows, client reporting, and day-to-day operations.
items.problem: Spreadsheets and ad-hoc tools created manual handoffs, unclear status, and reporting delays.
approach: Designed the product architecture and domain model around core agency operations.
Built a secure, self-hosted MVP using Next.js and Supabase, with data schemas for campaign performance and reporting.
Set up CI/CD and a handover so the team can operate the system.
impact: Left a foundation for later features and automations.
